name: side plank clamshell
description: A side plank where you open and close your top knee. It works the outer hips and the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
